entries.title: On Being Still
entries.body: "Be still and know that I am God" hit different at 2am on a hospital cot. Stillness isn't passivity — it's trust with its hands open...

entries.title: Psalm 23 in a Hospital Gown
entries.body: He makes me lie down — I never thought I'd read that line from a bed I didn't choose. But green pastures don't require a view...

entries.title: When the Answer Is "Wait"
entries.body: I asked for healing and got endurance instead. Studying Romans 5 this week taught me those aren't opposite gifts...
